observations.title: Describe native Create processing recipes
observations.player_action: Use the installed KubeJS Create integration to represent Create processing recipes in server recipe events.
observations.outcome: The integration supports processing families such as milling, crushing, pressing, mixing and compacting without replacing Create's machine lifecycle.
conditions: Recipe builders and names differ across KubeJS/Create versions; consult the installed integration before using an older wiki snippet.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 2001.3.0-build.8.
observations.review_note: Pack-author scripting workflow, not a survival objective. The owning script and native recipe event remain authoritative.

observations.title: Preserve heat and assembly requirements
observations.player_action: Represent required heating and ordered processing steps when authoring a mixing, compacting or sequenced assembly recipe.
observations.outcome: Heating state and processing order remain explicit recipe conditions; merely holding an output item does not prove the machine sequence was performed.
conditions: Standard smoking/blasting and Create bulk processing must not be confused with unsupported custom recipe types.
No recipe is added by this research.
